items.prompt: Why use a separate diagnostic Random instance during a simulation?

options.text: To guarantee perfect independence of every real-world input
options.why: State isolation cannot establish real-world independence.

options.text: To avoid diagnostics consuming the simulation stream state
options.why: Unrelated diagnostic draws should not change the intended simulation draw order.

options.text: To turn a pseudo-random generator into a cryptographic source
options.why: This module is not suitable for secrets.

options.text: To make restarting the same seed on every draw correct
options.why: That repeats the initial state instead of advancing it.

items.explanation: Local ownership of generator state separates unrelated consumers and makes reproduction easier to explain.
